propositions.name: ether_exists_and_fills_space
propositions.statement: The ether is a medium whose vibrations produce the phenomena of heat and light and which fills all space.

propositions.statement: The instrument is sensitive to vibrations, so the work could not be carried on during the day.

propositions.name: pavement_stamping_disturbs_fringes
propositions.statement: The instrument was so sensitive that the stamping of the pavement, about 100 meters from the observatory, made the fringes disappear entirely.

propositions.name: solar_system_moves_toward_hercules
propositions.statement: The earth's motion in its orbit coincides roughly in longitude with the estimated direction of the motion of the solar system, toward the constellation Hercules.
propositions.quote: the earth's motion in its orbit coincides roughly in longitude with the estimated direction of the motion of the solar system — namely, toward the constellation Hercules.

propositions.name: solar_motion_angle_to_equator
propositions.statement: The direction of the motion of the solar system is inclined at an angle of about +26° to the plane of the equator.

propositions.name: resultant_motion_vector_addition
propositions.statement: The nearer two components of motion are in magnitude to each other, the more nearly their resultant would coincide with the plane of the equator.

propositions.name: apparatus_orientation_arms_geometry

propositions.name: temperature_difference_causes_fringe_displacement

propositions.name: brass_expansion_displacement_magnitude
propositions.statement: A temperature only one one-hundredth of a degree higher on one arm than the other would cause the fringes to experience a displacement three times as great as that which would result from the rotation.
propositions.quote: if one arm should have a temperature only one one-hundredth of a degree higher than the other, the fringes would thereby experience a displacement three times as great as that which would result from the rotation.

propositions.name: brass_coefficient_value
propositions.statement: The arms are of brass whose coefficient of expansion is 0.000019 and have a length of about 1000 mm.
propositions.quote: These being of brass whose coefficient of expansion is 0.000019 and having a length of about 1000 mm.

propositions.name: temperature_effect_direction_independent
propositions.statement: The changes of temperature are independent of the direction of the arms, so if these changes were not too great their effect could be eliminated.

propositions.name: bending_during_rotation_displaces_fringes

propositions.name: support_asymmetry_causes_displacement
propositions.statement: The displacement observed in a particular direction was due entirely to the support, since turning the support through 90° also changed the direction of the displacement 90°.
propositions.quote: That this was due entirely to the support was proved by turning the latter through 90°, when the direction in which the displacement appeared was also changed 90°.

propositions.name: main_conclusion_no_displacement
propositions.statement: The interpretation of the results is that there is no displacement of the interference bands.
propositions.quote: The interpretation of these results is that there is no displacement of the interference bands.

propositions.name: stationary_ether_hypothesis_incorrect
propositions.statement: The result of the hypothesis of a stationary ether is shown to be incorrect, and the hypothesis is erroneous.
propositions.quote: The result of the hypothesis of a stationary ether is thus shown to be incorrect, and the necessary conclusion follows that the hypothesis is erroneous.

propositions.name: aberration_explanation_presupposes_earth_moves_through_ether
propositions.statement: The explanation of the phenomenon of aberration which has been hitherto generally accepted presupposes that the earth moves through the ether, the ether remaining at rest.
propositions.quote: This conclusion directly contradicts the explanation of the phenomenon of aberration which has been hitherto generally accepted, and which presupposes that the earth moves through the ether, the latter remaining at rest.

propositions.name: fresnel_theory_requires_ether_moving_through_solid_earth
propositions.statement: We would not be disposed to believe, without good evidence, that the ether moved quite freely through the solid mass of the earth.
propositions.quote: we would not be disposed to believe, without good evidence, that the ether moved quite freely through the solid mass of the earth.

propositions.name: two_theories_of_aberration_exist
propositions.statement: Two totally different theories run parallel to each other in the explanation of the phenomena.
propositions.quote: This affords a curious instance of two totally different theories running parallel to each other in the explanation of phenomena.
